text:
Marathon Petroleum is up 0.31% today, extending a strong two-week rally of 7.81%. The gains reflect tightening refinery dynamics: refineries are running at 98% capacity while diesel inventories sit at historically low levels, and recent news confirms diesel prices hit record highs as Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries and Iranian sanctions have knocked major competitors offline. For a company that profits from processing crude into fuel, higher fuel prices and tight supply create favorable margins.

The broader picture adds another tailwind — geopolitical turmoil is keeping oil prices elevated (US crude at $91.48, global at $96.02), and the U.S. deal with Venezuela could eventually increase crude supply but only over time, meaning near-term refinery economics remain tight. With capacity maxed out and competing refineries offline due to war and sanctions, Marathon's ability to produce and sell fuel at strong margins is supporting the stock's momentum.
